raw:
I’ve set up a provisional comparison; no analysis can run yet because all four options currently set no recorded levels.

These are **my assumptions, not measurements**, to adopt or correct in one go:

- **Starting point:** £0 capital spend; 0 installation hours; 85% reliability; 5,000 orders/quarter capacity.
- **Repair:** £10,000; 92% reliability. (The model does not currently link repair to downtime or capacity.)
- **Replace:** £40,000; 80 installation hours; 98% reliability; 6,500 orders/quarter capacity.
- **Also included for comparison:** continue current line (£0, 85%, 5,000); phased replacement (£35,000, 24 hours, 96%, 6,000).

The cost figures respect your £40,000 ceiling; the operational figures are illustrative assumptions based on the absence of measurements. Approve these assumptions?
